Name: Custom Chest Size
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Custom Chest Size[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Custom Chest Size lets you change the layout of regular chests and big chests by setting a custom number of rows and/or columns. Supports in-game config through GMCM.
I've made this mod because my girlfriend kept filling the chests with fishes, now there's plenty of space.
I haven't had the time to thoroughly test this and it's also the first mod I've made so any feedback/issues that you can report are appreciated. I'll do my best to solve them.


[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Change the number of rows and columns for all vanilla storage options[/*]
[*]Overflowed chests become take-only until the item count falls back under the limit.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] -> optional but recommended[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Adjust settings via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu in-game.[/*]
[/list]
